quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Many details here: who, from where, and when. Follow the family relationship.
quests.explanation: Only the relationship changed. A daughter and a niece are both family, but they are different people, and the pickup would be for a different child.
quests.prompt: Maria is picking up her daughter from dance class at half past five tomorrow.
quests.sampleAnswer: Maria is picking up her niece from dance class at half past five tomorrow.
quests.followUpQuestion: Repeat the sentence and name the person being picked up.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A lot of information is packed into one line: who, where, when and why.
quests.explanation: You heard exactly what was written. The reason "because of a new job" comes last, and it needs a noun after it.
quests.prompt: Our neighbours upstairs are moving to Canada in March because of a new job.
quests.sampleAnswer: Our neighbours upstairs are moving to Canada in March because of a new job.
quests.followUpQuestion: Retell the sentence in your own words.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Count the requests: how many, which day, and where to sit.
quests.explanation: "Preferably" softens the last part, since the speaker is not insisting.
quests.prompt: I need two tickets for the Saturday evening show, preferably near the front.
quests.sampleAnswer: I need two tickets for the Saturday evening show, preferably near the front.
quests.followUpQuestion: Ask for tickets to something you would like to see.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Follow the driver's action and his reason.
quests.explanation: Word for word the same. "Because nobody answered" explains why the parcel was left elsewhere.
quests.prompt: The delivery driver left the parcel with the receptionist because nobody answered the door.
quests.sampleAnswer: The delivery driver left the parcel with the receptionist because nobody answered the door.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say why a parcel might be left with someone else.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: An order has two counts. Listen to the first one.
quests.explanation: Two and three pizzas feed a different number of people. A small change here can leave colleagues hungry.
quests.prompt: Could you order two large pizzas and one salad for the team lunch on Thursday?
quests.sampleAnswer: Could you order three large pizzas and one salad for the team lunch on Thursday?
quests.followUpQuestion: Place a lunch order for your group.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The trip has a starting point and a destination.
quests.explanation: The departure stays the same, so only the destination changes. It changes what you would ask him about the weather and the trip.
quests.prompt: My brother is flying from Chicago to Denver next week for a job interview.
quests.sampleAnswer: My brother is flying from Chicago to Boston next week for a job interview.
quests.followUpQuestion: Describe a trip somebody in your family will take.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two consequences follow a condition. Track both of them.
quests.explanation: The condition uses the present tense, and the results use the future.
quests.prompt: If it's still raining at four, we'll cancel the picnic and go to the museum.
quests.sampleAnswer: If it's still raining at four, we'll cancel the picnic and go to the museum.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what your backup plan is for bad weather.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A routine with an exception at the very end.
quests.explanation: Nothing was altered in this one. "Except on" removes one day from the schedule, and it's easy to miss when spoken fast.
quests.prompt: The bakery near the station sells fresh bread every morning except on Mondays.
quests.sampleAnswer: The bakery near the station sells fresh bread every morning except on Mondays.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say a place that isn't open on one day.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A list of three things to bring. Hear all three.
quests.explanation: A charger and a notebook are both useful, but a person who only brings one of them may not be prepared.
quests.prompt: Please bring your laptop, a charger and a pen to the workshop on Wednesday.
quests.sampleAnswer: Please bring your laptop, a notebook and a pen to the workshop on Wednesday.
quests.followUpQuestion: Give someone a list of things to bring.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The promise is a time window. What happened is at the end.
quests.explanation: Showing up late and never showing up are both disappointing, but the customer would react differently.
quests.prompt: The plumber said he would come between nine and eleven, but he showed up late.
quests.sampleAnswer: The plumber said he would come between nine and eleven, but he never showed up.
quests.followUpQuestion: Complain about someone who didn't arrive on time.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two events are connected by "so". What was the result?
quests.explanation: "On the way home" says where she lost them, and "for an hour" says how long she had to wait.
quests.prompt: Anna lost her keys on the way home, so she waited outside for an hour.
quests.sampleAnswer: Anna lost her keys on the way home, so she waited outside for an hour.
quests.followUpQuestion: Tell a short story about something you lost.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The occasion of a meal is given at the end.
quests.explanation: A birthday and an anniversary are both celebrations, but they involve different people and different gifts.
quests.prompt: We're meeting my parents at the restaurant on Friday to celebrate my birthday.
quests.sampleAnswer: We're meeting my parents at the restaurant on Friday to celebrate their anniversary.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what you celebrate with your family.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two times appear in the message. How do they relate?
quests.explanation: "Sharp" means exactly, so late arrivals will miss the start.
quests.prompt: The training session starts at nine sharp, so please arrive ten minutes early.
quests.sampleAnswer: The training session starts at nine sharp, so please arrive ten minutes early.
quests.followUpQuestion: Give someone a reminder about a start time.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The booking includes a size, a place and a length. Focus on the place.
quests.explanation: Market and harbour are different areas of a town, so the guests would expect a different view and noise level.
quests.prompt: I've booked a small apartment near the market for four nights in July.
quests.sampleAnswer: I've booked a small apartment near the harbour for four nights in July.
quests.followUpQuestion: Describe where you would like to stay on holiday.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two deadlines: the ideal one and the last one.
quests.explanation: The recording follows the text word for word. "If necessary" shows the second deadline is only a backup.
quests.prompt: She'd like the report by Friday, but she can wait until Monday if necessary.
quests.sampleAnswer: She'd like the report by Friday, but she can wait until Monday if necessary.
quests.followUpQuestion: Give someone a deadline and a backup deadline.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: This is a description of a person. Listen for what he is wearing.
quests.explanation: Green and grey both start with the same sound. In a police report, mixing them up would mean looking for the wrong man.
quests.prompt: The tall man in the green coat asked me for directions to the station.
quests.sampleAnswer: The tall man in the grey coat asked me for directions to the station.
quests.followUpQuestion: Describe someone you saw today, using clothing.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The plan has a landing time and an estimate of when you'll be out.
quests.explanation: "Probably" tells you the speaker isn't sure about the time.
quests.prompt: My flight lands at eleven, but I'll probably be outside by noon.
quests.sampleAnswer: My flight lands at eleven, but I'll probably be outside by noon.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say when you'll arrive somewhere and how sure you are.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A question inside a question. Follow the two options.
quests.explanation: "Whether ... or" presents two possible answers inside an indirect question.
quests.prompt: Could you ask the chef whether the soup is vegetarian or has chicken stock?
quests.sampleAnswer: Could you ask the chef whether the soup is vegetarian or has chicken stock?
quests.followUpQuestion: Ask a waiter about the ingredients in a dish.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: The number of colleagues is at the very start.
quests.explanation: Three and two are close in sound. The rest of the sentence is unchanged, so you must count.
quests.prompt: Three of my colleagues are working from home today because the office is being painted.
quests.sampleAnswer: Two of my colleagues are working from home today because the office is being painted.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say who is working from home today.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: An appointment has a day, a part of the day and a time.
quests.explanation: Same in both. "Ten past three" is spoken as one phrase and means three ten.
quests.prompt: I'm afraid the doctor can only see you on Thursday afternoon at ten past three.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'm afraid the doctor can only see you on Thursday afternoon at ten past three.
quests.followUpQuestion: Offer someone an appointment time.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Free entry has an age limit and a day. Listen to which Sunday it is.
quests.explanation: First and last Sundays are separated by three weeks. A family planning a visit could easily turn up on the wrong day.
quests.prompt: The museum offers free entry for children under twelve on the last Sunday of each month.
quests.sampleAnswer: The museum offers free entry for children under twelve on the first Sunday of each month.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say when a place near you offers something for free.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A small mishap at the end. What did he forget?
quests.explanation: Phone and wallet lead to different problems. Without a wallet, he can't pay, but without a phone he can't call anyone.
quests.prompt: He ordered a coffee and a sandwich, then realised he'd left his phone at home.
quests.sampleAnswer: He ordered a coffee and a sandwich, then realised he'd left his wallet at home.
quests.followUpQuestion: Tell a story about forgetting something.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A condition has a deadline. Listen to the last words.
quests.explanation: Friday and the weekend are close but different. The decision would be made a few days later.
quests.prompt: We'll have to postpone the trip unless the weather improves by Friday.
quests.sampleAnswer: We'll have to postpone the trip unless the weather improves by the weekend.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say when you will make a decision, and what it depends on.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A message is relayed. Who, when, and why?
quests.explanation: This is a straight match. "Said" moves the tense one step back, so "would" replaces "will".
quests.prompt: The receptionist said the manager would call back after lunch to confirm the booking.
quests.sampleAnswer: The receptionist said the manager would call back after lunch to confirm the booking.
quests.followUpQuestion: Pass on a message you received to someone else.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: There is a short extra clause in the middle. It describes the cousin.
quests.explanation: A city name in a relative clause is easy to overlook. It gives extra information, but it's part of the meaning.
quests.prompt: My cousin, who lives in Vienna, is visiting us for two weeks in August.
quests.sampleAnswer: My cousin, who lives in Berlin, is visiting us for two weeks in August.
quests.followUpQuestion: Talk about someone you know who lives in another city.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two instructions are followed by a condition of what to bring.
quests.explanation: "Fill out" and "bring back" are both phrasal verbs used in offices.
quests.prompt: You'll need to fill out this form and bring it back with two photographs.
quests.sampleAnswer: You'll need to fill out this form and bring it back with two photographs.
quests.followUpQuestion: Explain to someone how to complete an application.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Cause, action and result all appear in one sentence.
quests.explanation: "That added forty minutes" is a relative clause describing the detour.
quests.prompt: Since the road was closed, we had to take a detour that added forty minutes.
quests.sampleAnswer: Since the road was closed, we had to take a detour that added forty minutes.
quests.followUpQuestion: Describe a trip that took longer than planned.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two documents and two languages appear in one sentence.
quests.explanation: French and Spanish are different languages, and a contract can't be in both at once. A lawyer or translator would need to know the exact one.
quests.prompt: The client wants the proposal in English, but the contract has to be in French.
quests.sampleAnswer: The client wants the proposal in English, but the contract has to be in Spanish.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say which languages you use in different situations.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: Two times and one restriction. Which kind of message is restricted?
quests.explanation: Emails and calls are different ways to reach someone. A colleague would use the wrong one.
quests.prompt: I'll be at my desk until six, but I won't be answering emails after five.
quests.sampleAnswer: I'll be at my desk until six, but I won't be answering calls after five.
quests.followUpQuestion: Explain how people can contact you and when.

quests.instruction: Listen and tilt to yes if the audio matches the text, or no if it doesn't.
quests.hint: A problem is followed by a workaround.
quests.explanation: Listening and reading agree here. The sentence puts the reason first, which is common when the problem sets the scene.
quests.prompt: Because the printer was jammed, I sent the documents to the copy shop nearby.
quests.sampleAnswer: Because the printer was jammed, I sent the documents to the copy shop nearby.
quests.followUpQuestion: Say what you did when a machine wasn't working.
